recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的中到大型胚細胞，核大且常有凹陷或摺痕、染色質細緻、可見核仁，外圍為中等量灰藍色細胞質並帶少許空泡；形態偏單核球樣，但譜系需靠流式細胞儀確認為混合表型急性白血病。
features: Cluster of intermediate to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Nuclei round to indented/folded, some with cleft or notched contours
Fine, dispersed chromatin with small but discernible nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue to basophilic cytoplasm with scattered fine vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Occasional smaller cell with more condensed chromatin; background red cells and smudged nuclear material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of intermediate to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented and folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and small visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount, grey-blue to basophilic, and contains scattered fine vacuoles; no Auer rods or distinct granules are identified. Normal maturing hematopoietic elements are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with markedly increased blasts; the monocytoid nuclear folding raises myelomonocytic differentiation, and in the setting of immunophenotypic B-lymphoid co-expression and KMT2A rearrangement, the findings support mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely, so exclusion relies on flow cytometry showing no B-lineage (CD19 with strong CD79a/CD22/CD10) or T-lineage (cytoplasmic CD3) commitment.
KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL (often CD10-negative) lacks MPO and monocytic markers, whereas MPAL shows a second myeloid/monocytic component.
APL-M3v has bilobed/folded nuclei but typically shows fine granules, strong MPO, CD34/HLA-DR negativity, and PML::RARA.
